card.name: The word juice in drinks lists
card.fires_on: The word juice or juices (including its pieces 'ju' and 'ice'), mostly right after 'fruit' or 'clear'. It appears in lists of drinks to mix with a drug or to take as clear liquids.

modes.label: Mixing with drink
modes.description: Juice named as a liquid to mix or swallow a dose with, alongside water or milk.
modes.example: Add ½ cup to 1 cup of water, fruit<< juice>>, or diet soft drinks.

modes.label: Clear liquid lists
modes.description: Juice listed among allowed clear liquids, often with 'without pulp'.
modes.example: clear<< juices>> without pulp, ginger ale and other sod

modes.label: Grapefruit juice
modes.description: Juice spelled across pieces in a grapefruit interaction note.

card.writes: It promotes juice-related words, so it pushes the model to complete a drink name as juice.
card.plain: It lights up on the word juice when a label lists drinks to take a medicine with or to drink before a procedure.
